findings.title: Public findMany() method removed without migrating callers
findings.body: The class's only query-executing public method, `findMany(findManyArgs)` (which applied the auth/filter conditions and called `this.prisma.bookingTimeStatusDenormalized.findMany`), is deleted and replaced by `getBaseConditions()`, which merely returns a raw `Prisma.Sql` fragment that callers must embed in their own `$queryRaw`. This PR only changes the service and its test file, so any existing caller of `insightsBookingService.findMany(...)` (e.g., the insights tRPC router that lists bookings) will fail type-checking/compilation after this merges. Either keep a query-executing method on the service or update all callers in the same PR.

findings.title: Caching behavior tests removed while caching logic remains in the service
findings.body: The entire `describe("Caching", ...)` block (which verified that repeated calls to `getAuthorizationConditions()` and `getFilterConditions()` return the cached result) was deleted rather than ported to the new `Prisma.Sql` format, yet the service still implements caching via `cachedAuthConditions`/`cachedFilterConditions` (including the subtle `undefined`-vs-`null` sentinel logic for filter conditions). Coverage for a still-active code path was dropped; the caching tests should have been converted like the others instead of removed.

findings.title: PR description misstates the scope of the change
findings.body: The description says 'This PR updates the InsightsBookingService integration tests to work with the new Prisma.sql format that was previously converted in the service implementation', but the diff shows the service itself is converted in this PR — including a public API change (removal of `findMany`, changed return types of `getAuthorizationConditions`/`getFilterConditions` from `BookingTimeStatusDenormalizedWhereInput` to `Prisma.Sql`). Reviewers following the description and its checklist will focus on the test file and miss the riskiest part of the change (raw SQL authorization conditions and the API break) in the service.
